share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-26), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows: the investing-activities section lists only fixed-maturity/equity/other-invested-asset flows, the net change in short-term investments and unsettled securities transactions, and proceeds from sale of renewal rights - there is no purchases-of-property-and-equipment (or any capex) line for FY2025, FY2024 or FY2023, and the balance sheet carries no property-and-equipment line. The statement fully reconciles without one: FY2025 operating $3,068M + investing $(2,096)M + financing $(1,175)M + FX $(28)M = the reported net decrease in cash of $(231)M exactly; FY2024: $4,957M - $4,478M - $383M + $16M = reported $112M exactly; FY2023: $4,553M - $5,902M + $1,409M - $23M = $37M vs reported $38M (rounding). EDGAR companyfacts for CIK 1095073 contains no capex fact under any candidate tag in any year.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex - capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 because the filer does not report a capex line at all; the filer's own cash-flow statements fully account for investing activities in all three years, so capex is $0 as a filing fact, not an estimate (same presentation as the CMPS/DFTX precedents). Any premises/equipment spend is aggregated inside the filed investing lines and is immaterial at insurer scale - even a hypothetical $50M would move OE by ~$1.2/share (~1% of the base). The engine's history already carried capex as assumed-zero, so the override changes no OE figure; it converts a silent zero-fill into a sourced, registered decision.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

The statement fully reconciles without one: FY2025 operating $3,068M + investing $(2,096)M + financing $(1,175)M + FX $(28)M = the reported net decrease in cash of $(231)M exactly; FY2024: $4,957M - $4,478M - $383M + $16M = reported $112M exactly; FY2023: $4,553M - $5,902M + $1,409M - $23M = $37M vs reported $38M (rounding). override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
